# PR tracker 

## Install

Add the fixed `0.1.1` npm release to the existing `plugins`
array in `~/.config/opencode/cli.json`:

```json
{ "plugins": ["@daoninc/opencode-pr-tracker@0.1.1"] }
```

Requires OpenCode V2 and a local authenticated GitHub CLI (`gh auth login`). Remove
the equivalent local entry when switching to npm. Do not enable this port alongside
the upstream tracker: their functionality overlaps, and published `0.1.0` still
shares its runtime ID. Version `0.1.1` uses `daoninc.pr-tracker` and ships
Solid-compiled JavaScript. Do not use the raw-TSX `0.1.0` build with OpenCode 2.3.1.
This package is TUI-only.

## Attribution and features

This TUI-only port is based on `@kitlangton/opencode-pr-tracker` 0.1.1
([source](https://github.com/kitlangton/opencode-plugins/tree/dd0de5a31b/packages/pr-tracker))
and the compatibility changes proposed in
[upstream PR #5](https://github.com/kitlangton/opencode-plugins/pull/5).
The upstream code is MIT-licensed; see `LICENSE`.

It uses the current OpenCode V2 TUI API and the host's rendering dependencies,
while retaining 0.1.1's session-scoped `gh pr create` tracking. It also shows
the PR associated with the active session's checked-out branch, including PRs
created outside the session, followed by your open PRs in the active repository
(`gh pr list --author @me --state open`, up to 100). Entries are deduplicated by
URL, with the current branch and session-created PRs listed first. All sources
are refreshed every 45 seconds. Closed or merged PRs disappear from the authored
list on the next successful refresh, but remain visible if tracked by the session
or current branch. Failed authored-list lookups retain the last successful list;
switching directories clears it and ignores late results from other directories. GitHub
lookups use each session's local working directory. `git` and an authenticated
`gh` CLI are required.

This package is maintained separately from upstream. Its version numbers are
independent. The upstream MIT license and copyright notice are included unchanged
in every package. Do not configure this plugin in the server's `opencode.json`.

The PR tracker icons:

| Icon | Meaning | Color |
|---|---|---|
| `◇` | Draft PR | Blue |
| `✓` | Merged | Purple |
| `×` | Closed, or CI checks failed/cancelled/timed out | Red |
| `◌` | CI checks pending or running | Yellow |
| `●` | Open with checks passed, or no checks | Green |

Draft status takes priority over the other indicators.
